titleStmt.title: Memorandum on Colonial Problems for Consideration of the Working Group

div.note: Department of State Committee files, lot 54 D 5, “Working Group on Colonial Problems”

head.hi: Memorandum on Colonial Problems for Consideration of the Working Group
